scope: Real isolated Go HTTP with production browser parsers and Node WebCrypto. No native desktop, browser pixels, input or public relay.
checks: Permanent PC identity and additive activation discovery/create use actual coordinator routes
Four independently proved browser/phone/agent identities connect using the same nine-digit PC ID and six-digit PIN; one input owner only
Pending sessions reserve the four-seat capacity; only the host can inspect its named roster and no controller bearer is exposed
Host approvals preserve the input/view-only permissions and the activation remains available after redemption
Ending the controller frees its slot for a new authorized connection; existing viewers never silently gain control
Deactivate ends pending and approved connections, clears the roster, and rejects later use of the same PC ID/PIN
